display.purpose: Manrope. Hero numbers, splash, big celebratory moments only. Rare.

headline.purpose: Manrope. Screen titles, section headers, dialog titles.

title.purpose: Inter. Card titles, list leads, button labels, app-bar title.

body.purpose: Inter. Paragraphs and descriptions; cap prose at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Inter. Chips, nav labels, metadata, overlines. Only place tracking opens up.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Default lift for elevated cards and active primary buttons. Diffuse, navy-tinted, low-opacity.

shadows.name: tinted
shadows.purpose: Colored glow under achievement/streak cards, using the card's own accent.

motion.name: transition-standard
motion.purpose: State changes (ease-out-quint). Convey state, not decoration. 150-250ms.

motion.name: haptic-light
motion.purpose: Tactile confirmation on primary CTA tap and habit/mood logging.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid Deep Harbor Teal pill, full-width, 56px. The default commit action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; background: #00668A; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00587A; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,102,138,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Hero Gradient Button
components.description: Signature CTA. Teal-to-Sky gradient pill with ambient shadow. One per screen, for the single most important action.
components.css: .ds-btn-hero { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00668A 0%, #38BDF8 100%); color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(11,28,48,0.12); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-hero:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-hero:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-hero:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(11,28,48,0.12), 0 0 0 3px rgba(56,189,248,0.45); }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Low-emphasis pill. Ghost stroke, primary label.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; background: #F8F9FF; color: #00668A; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid rgba(189,200,209,0.3); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: #EFF4FF; } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,102,138,0.3); }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Flat white card on the tinted surface field. No border; separation is the surface shift. Optional ambient lift.
components.html:
Meditación matinal
Racha de 12 días
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 24px; padding: 20px; color: #0B1C30; } .ds-card--elevated { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(11,28,48,0.06); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #0B1C30; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: #3E484F; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Soft filled well. No border at rest; primary border wakes on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 18px 20px; background: rgba(211,228,254,0.4); color: #0B1C30; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; border: none; border-radius: 24px; outline: none; transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(62,72,79,0.7); } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(0,102,138,0.4); } .ds-input.ds-input--error { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #BA1A1A; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Small-radius pill (the one place radius goes to 8px). Carries category bg/fg pair.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 10px; background: #CCFBF1; color: #115E59; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.5px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Glass floating nav. Transparent over a blurred surface, 72px, pill indicator at 25% on the active tab.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; height: 72px; padding: 8px 12px; background: rgba(248,249,255,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border-radius: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(189,200,209,0.15); } .ds-nav-item { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-ind { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 30px; border-radius: 999px; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item--active .ds-nav-ind { background: rgba(56,189,248,0.25); } .ds-nav-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.4px; color: #00668A; } .ds-nav-label--muted { font-weight: 500; color: #3E484F; }

narrative.overview: HabitAI feels like a thoughtful friend who happens to keep beautiful notes. The system pairs an editorial display voice (Manrope, set large and tightly tracked) with a calm, layered field of sky-tinted surfaces. Color is mostly held back so that when a streak amber or a hero teal gradient appears, it reads as a small reward, not as decoration. Depth comes from stacking near-white surfaces in faint blue steps, never from hard rules or heavy shadows. The register is product: the interface serves a sub-two-minute daily ritual. The most distinctive structural decision is the refusal of the 1px hard border; separation is carried by tonal surface shifts and a soft ambient shadow reserved for genuine elevation.
keyCharacteristics: Dual typography: Manrope for display and headlines, Inter for everything functional.
Sky-tinted neutral system: every surface and text neutral leans toward the brand blue, never pure gray.
Generous, consistent radii (24px cards, 32px dialogs, 36px sheets, full-pill buttons).
Color as reward: teal hero gradient and streak amber appear sparingly, against a restrained field.
No hard borders: depth via tonal surface layering and ambient shadow only.

rules.name: The Color-As-Reward Rule
rules.body: The teal hero gradient and streak amber are earned moments, not background texture. On a resting screen, the dominant colors are sky-tinted neutrals; saturated color covers a small fraction of the surface and marks a primary action or an achievement. Never wash a whole screen in primary.

rules.name: The Navy-Tint Rule
rules.body: No neutral is ever pure gray or pure black. Every surface, text, and outline color is tinted toward the brand blue. If a neutral looks gray next to the surfaces, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Manrope speaks only at display and headline scale. Inter owns titles, body, labels, buttons, and all data. Never set body or a button in Manrope; never set a screen title in Inter.

rules.name: The Surface-Shift-First Rule
rules.body: To separate two layers, change the surface step before reaching for a shadow. A card is surface-container-lowest on a surface field; that contrast alone is the separation. Shadow is added only when an element must read as floating above the plane.

rules.name: The Ghost-Border Rule
rules.body: Hard 1px strokes are forbidden. The only allowed seam is the ghost border, outline-variant at 15% opacity, and only where a divider is truly needed.

dos: Do anchor primary actions in Deep Harbor Teal (#00668A) and reserve the Teal-to-Sky hero gradient for the single most important CTA on a screen.
Do separate layers with the surface ladder before reaching for any shadow.
Do keep radii generous and consistent: 24px cards, 32px dialogs, 36px sheets, full-pill buttons.
Do tint every neutral toward navy/blue. Pure gray is a bug.
Do reserve Streak Amber (#F59E0B) for streaks, achievements, and gamification.
Do set screen titles and hero numbers in Manrope; set everything functional in Inter.
donts: Don't use a 1px hard border anywhere. The only seam allowed is the ghost border (outline-variant at 15%). No side-stripe borders ever.
Don't wash a whole screen in saturated primary; color is a reward, not a background.
Don't feel like a corporate productivity tool, clinical health app, aggressive gamification, or a diary app.
Don't apply glassmorphism to content cards. Glass is for floating chrome only (nav, FAB, overlays).
Don't set body text, labels, or buttons in Manrope; don't set screen titles in Inter.
Don't add shadows to elements that aren't actually floating. Elevation 0 is the default.
Don't reuse the Mood rating/label colors as general UI accents; they belong to the mood feature only.
